artworks.title: James I
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait showing the subject from the waist up. The person is positioned facing slightly to the side, with their head turned towards the viewer. They have a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, with short, wavy hair that is combed back. The clothing consists of a richly detailed outfit with a visible buttoned garment underneath a prominent high, ruffled lace collar and fur-trimmed cloak. Around the neck, there is a chain or necklace with a medallion hanging down. The background contains ornate text surrounding the oval frame of the portrait, with additional text beneath the image detailing it further. The outer edge of the portrait features decorative designs.

artworks.title: James I, King of Great Britain
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 14.8 x 11.1 cm (5 13/16 x 4 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man wearing ornate armor. He has a beard and mustache, and his head is turned slightly to the side. The background features a textured oval border with surrounding text.

artworks.title: Anne of Denmark, Queen of Scotland and England
artworks.description: The image displays an upper-body portrayal of a woman facing forward. She has a long, straight nose, full lips, and a slight chin cleft. Her hair is styled high and wide with small pearls, and she wears a decorative piece on her forehead. She is dressed in a heavily decorated garment with an intricate high collar and a pattern resembling flowers or stars. She adorns her neck with a long string of pearls with larger floral motifs interspersed, forming a Y-shaped drape over her chest. The background consists of finely detailed vertical lines.

artworks.title: Anne of Denmark, Queen of Scotland and England
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman with an oval face, high cheekbones, a narrow nose, and slightly parted lips. Her hair is styled upwards with a central part and adorned with jewelry near her left eyebrow. She wears a gown with a large lace ruff around her shoulders decorated with a floral pattern and a chain of pearls and jewels across her chest. The background consists of a simple linear pattern.

artworks.title: Anne of Denmark, Queen of James I
artworks.description: This is an engraving of a woman with an elaborate hairstyle and clothing. She is facing forward with her head slightly turned to the right. She has a high forehead, arched eyebrows, prominent eyes, a straight nose, and a neutral expression. Her hair is styled in a voluminous updo and adorned with a headpiece and jewel. She is dressed in a detailed gown with floral designs, lace trim, and a large lace ruff around her neck. She wears pearl jewelry, including a necklace and earrings with a hanging pendant. The background features text and decorative elements with finely detailed line work and shading.

artworks.title: Anne of Denmark, Queen of James I
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a person with intricate details. The portrait depicts the upper body and head of the person facing slightly to the side. The person has delicate features such as eyebrows, eyes, nose, and mouth. The hair is styled upwards. The person is dressed in elaborate attire with a high collar, lace patterns, and a strand of pearls. Earrings are visible. The person is enclosed within an oval frame with inscriptions in Latin. The background features detailed line work and shading typical of engravings of that period, with no specific scenery depicted beyond the oval.

artworks.title: Charles I as Prince of Wales
artworks.description: The image displays a bust-length portrait of an individual facing forward with slightly turned shoulders. The facial features include a slender face, long nose, pointed chin, small eyes, and pursed lips. The individual has shoulder-length hair neatly styled and wearing a richly detailed garment with ornate patterns, lace collar, outer cloak, and a jeweled chain. The portrait is set within an oval frame with detailed line work and Latin text. The background consists of fine horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Charles I as Prince of Wales
artworks.description: The image is of an engraving featuring a man from the waist up. He is positioned slightly turned to the side but facing forward, with a composed expression. He has defined eyes, a prominent nose, slightly parted lips, short styled back hair, and is wearing a high ruff, detailed cloak, and ornate armor with patterns. The backdrop includes organic and heraldic designs, such as ribbons and foliage. Below him, a shield with a crest of three feathers and a ribbon saying "ICH DIEN" is displayed. An inscription at the bottom dedicates the portrait, emphasizing the subject's status.

artworks.title: Charles I
artworks.description: The image displays a waist-up portrait of a man seated in a regal posture. The man has a narrow face, a pointed mustache, and a small pointed beard under his lower lip. His hair is wavy and brushed back. He is wearing opulent clothing and an ornate chain with medallions over his shoulders. The man also wears a broad ruffled collar. The background features cross-hatched shading and there is text around the circular frame of the portrait.

artworks.title: Betrothal of Princess Elizabeth and Frederic V, Elector Palatine
artworks.description: The image depicts a man and a woman standing facing each other, clasping their right hands together. The man, on the left, wears a hat, a robe with a high collar, a tunic, pantaloons, and shoes. His face shows a stern expression, a defined nose, and no visible facial hair. The woman, on the right, wears a gown with a lace ruff around her neck, styled hair with a headpiece, and holds a fan in her left hand. The background features drapes, a patterned floor, and an illuminated circle with Hebrew characters.

artworks.title: Elizabeth, Queen of Bohemia
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a woman in an ornate oval frame. She has a slender face, a prominent nose, slightly arched eyebrows, and neutral expression. Her hair is styled back with ornamental details and pearls. She wears a high-collared dress with a ruff collar, pearls, and lace patterns. The background features intricate designs and symbols related to music and writing, along with a winged medallion. Inscriptions frame the portrait above and below.

artworks.title: Elizabeth, Queen of Bohemia (?)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the upper torso upwards. The individual is positioned facing forward with their head slightly tilted. They have finely arched eyebrows, a delicate nose, and slightly pursed lips. Their hair is styled in an elaborate manner, swept back and adorned with decorative components, including a hairpin. The person is wearing an ornate outfit characterized by an intricately detailed lace ruff around their neck and a gown embellished with a pattern of flowers along the edges. They have a beaded necklace with a hanging element, and ear jewelry is also visible. The background consists of a textured, lined pattern.

artworks.title: Elizabeth, Queen of Bohemia
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the waist up. The individual is positioned slightly turned to their right, gazing towards the viewer. Their face exhibits refined features with delicate eyes, and their hair is styled elegantly, adorned with a headpiece featuring pearls and a grand feather. They are wearing an opulent gown with intricate patterns and lace, featuring puffed sleeves and a high, ruffled collar. A large, ornate piece of jewelry or decoration is prominently displayed on their chest. The background appears to be a textured, dark area with a light fabric slightly visible on the side. The portrait is encased in an oval frame with text inscribed around it.

artworks.title: Elizabeth, Queen of Bohemia
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a woman. She is positioned facing slightly to her left, looking directly at the viewer. The woman has a delicate face with pronounced features such as her eyes, nose, and a gentle expression. Her curly hair falls to her shoulders and is adorned with a headpiece. She is dressed in an elaborate gown with lace and embroidery details, accentuated by a high, ornate collar. Around her neck, she wears a pearl necklace and there is a jeweled decorative piece pinned to her garment, which appears to include pearls. The background is a detailed oval framing her image, and surrounding the frame are words in an elegant script.

artworks.title: Elizabeth, Queen of Bohemia
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the waist up, facing forward and looking slightly to the left. She has a narrow face and a composed expression, with eyes directed straight ahead. Her hair is styled in an elaborate updo with a jeweled headband and a plume or feather detail. She wears an ornate dress with a high, pleated lace collar and a richly patterned front, along with decorative elements and a large pendant with intricate patterns and central jewels hanging from her neck. She also wears dangling pearl earrings. The background features an oval frame with inscriptions and decorative elements on a textured background.

artworks.title: Frederick V as Count Palatine
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man in three-quarter view, facing slightly left. He has a straight nose, high cheekbones, and a determined gaze. His hair is styled back and neat, with some waves. He wears elaborate late Renaissance or early Baroque clothing: a wide lace collar, an embroidered doublet with shoulder armor, and a diagonal sash. The background is a textured oval frame with surrounding text.

artworks.title: Frederick V, Elector Palatine, King of Bohemia
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a person within an oval frame. The person has a delicate face with medium-length hair, wearing an elaborate period garment with a high ruffled collar. They have a sash across their chest. The ornate frame around the portrait features heraldic imagery, including a globe topped with a crown, flags, swords, shields, lion figures, and scrollwork. The background consists solely of the decorative frame.

artworks.title: Frederick V, Elector Palatine, King of Bohemia
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a person within a decorative oval frame. The individual is shown from the waist up, facing slightly to the right. They have refined facial features, medium-length hair styled away from the face, and wear a detailed doublet with a large ruff around the neck. The oval frame is surrounded by heraldic imagery, including lion heads, flags, and swords intertwined with scrollwork. The background lacks any discernible landscape or interior, as the heraldic border dominates the composition.

artworks.title: Frederick V, Elector Palatine, King of Bohemia
artworks.description: The image depicts a man with sharply defined facial features, wearing an elaborate crown adorned with jewels and filigree. He has a somewhat solemn expression, with a prominent nose, high cheekbones, and a small mouth. His hair is neatly groomed and styled to frame his face. The man is dressed in a richly decorated ruff and a cloak with intricate patterns. He is holding an orb and a scepter, traditional symbols of monarchy and power. The background features ornate decorations and regal symbols like banners, swords, and a lion's face within a decorative circular frame with text inscribed. Additional elements like draped fabric enhance the sense of nobility and authority.

artworks.title: Frederick V, Elector Palatine, King of Bohemia
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man facing slightly to his left. He has defined facial features, a mustache, and a small pointed beard. His hair is styled back, reaching just past his ears. He is wearing an outfit with a high lace collar and an ornate doublet. In the background, there are two cherubs holding up a crown and a shield with guardsticks. The background is detailed with line work, likely an engraving, and features text beneath the oval border.

artworks.title: Frederick V, King of Bohemia
artworks.description: This engraving features a bust portrait of a man dressed in Elizabethan attire, with a crown above his head. The man has short, curly hair, a mustache and goatee, and is adorned in an elaborate outfit with a high collar and decorated doublet. Surrounding the portrait is an oval frame with text, set within an architectural facade. Seated female figures flank the portrait, one holding a sword and shield, the other a feather quill. Below them sits a crowned lion with a sword and orb. The background includes classical architectural motifs with columns and pediments, all depicted using fine linework to convey textures and patterns.

artworks.title: Frederick V, King of Bohemia
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting the upper body of a formal, seated man. His face is turned slightly to the left, looking directly at the viewer. He has defined facial features with a prominent nose, voluminous eyebrows, a mustache, and short, curly dark hair. The man is wearing an elaborate outfit with visible striped armor on his right arm, a large ruffled collar, and a draped sash crossing his chest. He holds a baton-like object in his right hand. Surrounding the portrait is an ornate oval frame with inscriptions, flanked by two seated female figures and a crowned coat of arms at the top. The background features intricate, symbolic engravings.

artworks.title: Frederick V, King of Bohemia, Standing in a Niche
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body depiction of a historical figure standing in a regal pose within an arched niche. The individual is facing forward, with his head slightly turned to the side. His features are detailed, including eyes, nose, and a slight smile. He has a short hairstyle and is wearing a crown. The attire is ornate and elaborate, with a high ruff around the neck and a layered, patterned doublet. A cape with a large fur collar drapes over his shoulders and arms. He holds a scepter in one hand and a baton in the other. The background features an arch labeled "FREDE RICUS" with two cherubs at the top holding a shield adorned with decorative symbols and a crown.

artworks.title: Frederick V
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing and facing forward. He has a mustache and a small goatee, with short, wavy hair under his hat. He is wearing an elaborate outfit with a wide-brimmed hat adorned with a decorative band and a feather, a large, ruffled white lace collar, a coat with intricate patterns and designs, a sash tied around his waist, lace cuffs, and a decorative sword at his side. The man's head is slightly turned to his right, and he is holding an object in his left hand. The background is a simple, dark texture.
